data.exact_reserve_text: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 12m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2020 (2019 GBP 1m). The reserve release was primarily due to the Property and PCR accounts offset by deterioration in Tech Liability.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports an aggregate prior-year reserve release in 2020. On a net (after reinsurance) basis the report states a GBP 12m release; using the published gross claims development triangle the gross prior-year movement is a modest release of approximately GBP 3.05m (c. -1.03% of opening gross claims outstanding). The release was driven primarily by favourable development in the Property and Political & Credit Risk (PCR) accounts, partly offset by deterioration in Tech Liability. The year also included a Part VII / RITC transfer of older EEA years which affected the reserves presentation.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 12m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2020 (2019 GBP 1m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the Property and PCR accounts offset by deterioration in Tech Liability.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year development was not given explicitly as a single gross figure. The report states a net (after reinsurance) prior year release of GBP 12m; a gross prior-year movement was derived from the published gross claims development triangle (2018 column) giving an approximate gross release of GBP 3.048m. The reserve picture is affected by a Part VII / RITC transfer (2017 & prior) during 2020 which distorts aggregate movements; this was considered when preferring the triangle for gross PYD. Amounts for LOB-level movements are described qualitatively in the report and not quantified, so LOB amounts are null.
